content: Microsoft Graph createUploadSession supports resumable uploads with PUT byte ranges under 60 MiB each and ranges as multiples of 320 KiB. Use nextExpectedRanges via GET uploadUrl to resume after interruption. If-Match and If-None-Match return 412 Precondition Failed. 429 returns Retry-After and requires exponential backoff. Use resumable uploads above 10 MiB. Do not send Authorization header on PUT to preauthenticated upload URL.
